entries.semantics: This is applicability evidence for evaluating the two source-reported analytic fits within [100,1000]. It is not a transcription of the raw sampled tau_Q grid and does not support queries below 100 for both branches.
entries.transcription: Panels (a) and (b) display the reported fitted incompressible-kinetic-energy curves for T=10^-6 and T=1. Both fitted curve segments visibly cover the labeled quench-duration interval from tau_Q=10^2 through tau_Q=10^3.
